label: Exploratory V5 C4 with prepared Spoolburst, Spun Cocoon, and Threadback Unweave candidate F4
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, reward, UI, or asset authority.
It keeps Candidate C4's ideal-direct-hit range/damage values, including 80 direct Spoolburst damage, forward-Stitch, and equal 128-unit Escape Slack reserve.

Spoolburst cannot be cast immediately. Its caster spends one full in-range turn preparing it; the stationary release is available only on that caster's immediately following turn if the target remains in range.

Preparation creates one Spun Cocoon hit that absorbs the next incoming Needlepoint or Spoolburst direct damage without clearing preparation. A normal Threadball Strike deals its normal 45 direct damage through the Cocoon and leaves the charge intact.

The separate zero-damage Threadball Unweave clears both Cocoon and preparation only when its caster can take one full legal 64-unit step away using that caster's existing Escape Slack. The action is unavailable otherwise, so cancellation leaves position and reserve residue rather than recreating F2's return loop.
Fire still ends the caster's turn. Terrain, aim, splash, animation, UI, and production counter-effects remain excluded.
